MAL.1.1-3.text: The LORD says he loved Jacob but hated Esau

MAL.1.4-5.text: The LORD will destroy what Edom rebuilds

MAL.1.6-7.text: The LORD says the priests despise his name

MAL.1.8-9.text: The LORD rejects the priests’ blind and sick animals

MAL.1.10-12.text: The LORD will accept no offering from the priests

MAL.1.13-14.text: The LORD condemns the priests for offering bad animals

MAL.2.1-2.text: The LORD warns the priests of a curse

MAL.2.3-4.text: The LORD will punish the priests’ descendants

MAL.2.5-7.text: Levi honored God and taught the truth

MAL.2.8-9.text: The priests turned from God’s way and taught wrongly

MAL.2.10-12.text: Judah’s men marry women who serve foreign gods

MAL.2.13-13.text: The LORD no longer accepts the people’s offerings

MAL.2.14-16.text: The LORD hates divorce and wants husbands to be faithful

MAL.2.17-17.text: The people tire the LORD by saying evil is good

MAL.3.1-3.text: The LORD will send a messenger and come to his temple

MAL.3.4-5.text: The LORD will judge sorcerers, adulterers and oppressors

MAL.3.6-7.text: The LORD does not change and calls Israel to return

MAL.3.8-9.text: The people rob God by not giving tithes and offerings

MAL.3.10-12.text: The LORD promises blessing for the full tithe

MAL.3.13-15.text: The people say that serving God is useless

MAL.3.16-16.text: A scroll is written for those who fear the LORD

MAL.3.17-18.text: The LORD will spare those who serve him

MAL.4.1-3.text: The LORD’s day will burn evildoers but heal believers

MAL.4.4-6.text: Israel must remember the law and Elijah will come
